text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts observed for /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings since ~03:22 UTC. Pager sent to #oncall. KPIs: 5xx rate up ~6% (baseline 0.4%), P50 latency +120ms, P95 spikes >3s. Possible root: increased KV prefix miss rate on prefix-cache shards 11-13. Please respond.
oncall-alex: acknowledging, i'm online. seeing a lot of 502/504 from api-gateway logs. bringing up the dashboard now :eyes:
sre-maya: i see a sharp spike in prefix-cache missrate and concurrent rehydrations. some shards show sustained io ops. also errors like "kv: checksum mismatch" on shard 12 intermittently.
eng-runtime-jin: copying logs from runtime nodes:
```
2026-03-15T03:23:12Z runtime-07 error kv/prefix: read shard=12 key=abc... err=checksum_mismatch
2026-03-15T03:23:14Z runtime-11 warn cache/prefetch: missstorm backpressure exceeded, enqueue=312
```
eng-ml-sam: customer-facing model endpoints show retries and client-side timeouts. looks correlated to the cache spikes.
oncall-alex: initial triage: likely either (A) corruption on shard 12 causing many reads to fall through and trigger upstream DB load and thundering herd; or (B) an aggressive eviction/batch cleanup that started at 03:20. which config rollouts touched prefix-cache in last hour?
deploy-bot: Recent deploys: runtime v5.3.8 rolled at 02:58 UTC (no prefix-cache changes). ops-config v1.12.4 rolled at 03:10 UTC with param `prefetch.max_concurrency=256` and `shard.evict_batch=2048`.
sre-maya: that config change at 03:10 looks suspicious. prefetch.max_concurrency jump could amplify missstorm. recommend reverting `prefetch.max_concurrency` to previous value (64) as immediate mitig.
eng-runtime-jin: agree. mitigation plan:
1) revert ops-config v1.12.4 -> rollback prefetch.max_concurrency to 64 (hotfix) :zap:
2) temporarily enable prefix-cache fallback: route cache misses to read-through queue with token-bucket throttling to avoid DB overload
3) mark shard 12 as degraded and force async repair/rehydration background job
4) add short-term increased retry/backoff at api-gateway to reduce 429/502 noise
I'll run 1 and 2 now. /run rkvctl config rollback --param=prefetch.max_concurrency --to=64
oncall-alex: running the rollback now. psql/ops API call in progress.
eng-runtime-jin: rollback applied to 50% of hosts. monitoring.
sre-maya: observing missrate dropping on some shards but shard 12 still noisy. checksum_mismatch persists.
eng-runtime-jin: starting repair dry-run: `rkvctl repair-shard --shard=12 --dry-run` output shows ~0.2% inconsistent entries and CRC drift on a subset of segments.
eng-runtime-jin: proceeding with repair (non-blocking) to avoid long pause: `rkvctl repair-shard --shard=12 --mode=streaming --max-concurrency=4`
sre-maya: streaming repair started. this will slowly rewrite healthy segments and should reduce checksum errors. it will cause some rehydrations.
customer-success-lucia: heads-up: we have 2 enterprise customers seeing errors in production (account IDs C-112 and C-420). CS is messaging them and will escalate if they ask for timeline.
oncall-alex: enabling throttled fallback and increasing DB read pool for a short window to absorb rehydrations. adding a guard to block aggressive prefetch on repaired shards.
eng-ml-sam: from model infra side, recommend enabling model-variant fallback for critical customers to a smaller-context variant to reduce token pressure during this window. can we do route overrides?
eng-runtime-jin: yes, can add route override for the two accounts to use model-v1-small for next 30m. applying now.
oncall-alex: quick status: rollback done across all hosts at 03:34 UTC, fallback enabled, repair streaming in progress. 5xx rate dropped from +6%->+2% but still above baseline. P95 latency improving slowly.
eng-runtime-jin: additional logs:
```
2026-03-15T03:36:02Z repair-12 info streaming: segment 7 rewritten, crc_ok=1
2026-03-15T03:37:40Z runtime-09 info cache/prefetch: throttle applied shard=12 token_bucket=200
```
sre-maya: observed a brief spike in DB read latency at 03:36 when repair hit a hot segment. increased read pool seems to have handled it.
oncall-alex: sus: there are a few instances where shard 12 still returns intermittent checksum_mismatch causing code path to treat as empty -> backfill -> clients racing. propose we set shard 12 to 'read-only cached' and divert writes until repair completes.
eng-runtime-jin: making shard 12 readonly for writes now. command: `rkvctl shard set-mode 12 readonly` -> applied.
customer-success-lucia: status message drafted and sent to impacted customers. they asked for ETA; told them ~1-2 hours for stabilization. keeping them updated.
eng-ml-sam: any impact on billing or token accounting? we should make sure retries don't double-bill customers.
oncall-alex: good catch. enabling token dedupe on retry and pausing any aggressive billing hooks. finance/usage will get a note.
eng-runtime-jin: repair progressing, now 60% segments healthy. 5xx at ~1.1% now.
sre-maya: recommend still prepping a fallback plan: if repair isn't fully healthy in 45m, we'll promote a cold-cache fallback (force read-through to secondary cache region) and open a brief maintenance window for shard-level repair with exclusive lock.
oncall-alex: agree. creating incident ticket INC-20260315-042 with timeline and mitigation steps. handoff: i'm oncall until 04:20 UTC, after that @sre-maya will take lead. leaving notes below.
oncall-alex: HANDOFF NOTES: rollback applied -> prefetch.max_concurrency=64; prefix-cache fallback enabled with 300rps throttle; shard 12 set readonly; streaming repair started@03:38 UTC; route override for accounts C-112/C-420 to model-v1-small; DB read pool bumped; customer comms in flight; monitor P95 and 5xx. paging thresholds lowered for SLO watchers.
sre-maya: taking over at 04:20 UTC. I'll keep watch on repair progress and escalate to full maintenance if checksum_mismatch continues after another 30m. reach me @sre-maya or pager.
oncall-alex: thx team. closing pager for me. :white_check_mark:
sre-maya: quick follow-up: please schedule a postmortem, include config rollout approvals for ops-config and add a preflight for prefetch changes. also add a test to simulate prefix-cache missstorm in staging.
eng-runtime-jin: noted. will add postmortem and create a replayable test harness for missstorm scenario.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: 03:58 UTC — 5xx trending down. repair 76% complete. next update or handoff at 04:20 UTC.
oncall-alex: final note before handoff: watch for residual client retries causing quota spikes. hold any non-critical deploys for next 2 hours. thanks everyone.
sre-maya: acknowledged. continuing monitoring.
deploy-bot: Scheduled pause on non-critical deploys until 06:00 UTC (per incident flag).
customer-success-lucia: i'll follow up with the two impacted customers after stabilization, set them to high-touch for 24h.
eng-ml-sam: adding eval checks to detect quality regressions from route overrides.
oncall-alex: handing off. matt out.
sre-maya: received handoff, taking lead. :hand:
